info.title: API.SH: Royal Caribbean
info.description: The Royal Caribbean API from API.SH: public Royal Caribbean data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Royal Caribbean cruise: name, nights, ship, departure port, destination, deal highlights, the day-by-day itinerary with port arrival and departure times, pre- and post-cruise tours, images, and every sailing date with full fares per stateroom class (price per guest, original and net price, discount, taxes and fees, promotion flags) and its booking link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/royal-caribbean-cruise

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The cruise id (from /royal-caribbean/v1/search `id`), or a royalcaribbean.com cruise link with its `groupId`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market whose fares to show (default `USA`; see /royal-caribbean/v1/search).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the fares (default: the market's own).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/royal-caribbean-featured-destinations

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

destinations.name: Bahamas
destinations.description: Discover turquoise waters and sunny island vibes.

get.description:
Every filter of Royal Caribbean's cruise search with its options and the number of matching sailings: destinations, ships, departure ports (grouped by region), port regions with nested countries and ports, places visited, special collections, voyage types, the nights range, the sail-date range, states of residence and sort orders. Pass the same filters as /royal-caribbean/v1/search to get counts for that search; `param` names the search parameter each filter maps to.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/royal-caribbean-filters

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Optional: count options within these destination codes (any /royal-caribbean/v1/search filter works here).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Royal Caribbean cruises matching the site's cruise search, with every filter it offers: destination, ship, departure port, ports visited, nights, sail dates, special collections, accessible staterooms, guest qualifiers (senior, military, police, state of residence) and sort, in any of the site's markets and currencies. Each cruise has its id, name, nights, ship, departure port, destination, deal highlights, the lowest-priced sailing (price per guest with taxes and fees, discount, original price), every sailing date with its price per stateroom class (interior, outside, balcony, suite), the day-by-day itinerary (port, arrival and departure times), pre- and post-cruise tours, images and its page link. Codes for the filters come from /royal-caribbean/v1/filters. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/royal-caribbean-search

parameters.name: ship
parameters.description: Ship codes, comma-separated (e.g. `WN` Wonder of the Seas, `IC` Icon of the Seas).

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port or port-region codes of the site's port filter, comma-separated.

parameters.name: visiting
parameters.description: Places visited (port, country or region codes of the site's visiting filter), comma-separated.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Special collection codes (the site's custom filter, e.g. `ICON`, `WEEKENDGETAWAYS`), comma-separated.

parameters.name: senior
parameters.description: Apply senior guest rates where offered.

parameters.name: police
parameters.description: Apply police and fire rates where offered.

parameters.name: resident
parameters.description: State or province of residence for resident rates (e.g. `FL`).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the fares (default: the market's own, e.g. GBP for GBR).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Royal Caribbean ship: code, name, images, stateroom classes (category, maximum guests, amenities and size text, images) and the facts its page on the site shows (class, decks, activities, places to dine and drink, a fun fact, the description and the page's section headings). Search its cruises with /royal-caribbean/v1/search `ship`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/royal-caribbean-ship

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Ship code (e.g. `WN`), name (e.g. `Wonder of the Seas`) or its royalcaribbean.com/cruise-ships/... link.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Also read the ship's page facts (default true).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
